title: The Landfall of the Upper Fly River
author: Quentin Thornbury
blurb: Rafael Okafor, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
